review_evidence: README identifies a formally verified HTTPS server with hundreds of machine-checked theorems and executable specifications.
Primary modules cover TLS/HTTP2/QUIC/WebSocket/gRPC, cryptography, state machines, server middleware, databases, and proof-bearing interfaces.

Main.lean, examples/basic-server/Main.lean, Benchmark.lean, FFI.lean, and the tests were inspected as candidate roles; they contain integration/interface/property code rather than a source-local lossless class that can be dropped wholesale.
summary: Reviewed the complete LeanServer source; verified protocol/server definitions and its test/property/integration code remain searchable with no additional blacklist.
